paraphrase: Images and PDFs attached to a note can be annotated in place (lines, shapes, arrows, text), which implies an in-note PDF view.

A note can be shared by link with an 'anyone with the link can view' setting (formerly 'share a note via public link').
Comments exist and are labelled a beta feature; team spaces exist on Evernote Teams (4403442292371). Real-time multiplayer and @mentions are not evidenced by these pages.
The AI Assistant prioritises the selection or open note and, if needed, expands to other notes on its own; the scope is decided by the assistant, not declared by the member.
